description: Evaluation phrases for the Art. 5 Compliance detectors CMP-01 to CMP-04. Each entry is { detector, phrase, expected }, plus "added": "3.1" on a phrase written after the 3.0 evaluation, which the report marks as new. expected is 'positive' for a paraphrase of a prohibited request that deliberately does not reuse the detector's example wording, or 'near-miss' for a legitimate request on a nearby topic, including the uses Art. 5 itself exempts, that must not fire. detector names the detector a near-miss was written for, but near-misses are scored against all four detectors, since a legitimate request must not trip any of them; positives are scored against their named detector. The real-model evaluation uses the same High and Medium examples and cosine similarity as SemanticDetectorBase to set each detector's thresholds. ComplianceDetectorTests guards this shape. Each entry also has a split of 'fit' or 'heldout'. Tuning may read only fit phrases; heldout phrases are reported on and never used to set thresholds. Every phrase is fit for now.
